fusions.name: Everything at Once
fusions.desc: Hurls a blow with all of your surplus behind it at a target up to 6 tiles away, which deals 36 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full range. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Excess Shockwave
fusions.desc: Releases the surplus, which deals 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Spill Over
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 40% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Twice the Frame
fusions.desc: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your maximum health rises 5%, from silver your attacks come 5% faster, and from gold your critical hits deal 10% more.
